youtube.title: Challenger: The Engineers Who Tried to Stop the Launch
youtube.description:
Six months before Challenger, Thiokol engineer Roger Boisjoly warned of "a catastrophe of the highest order." The night before launch, his team told NASA not to fly in the cold. Here is the memo, the late-night call, the 'management hat', and what Richard Feynman showed the world with a glass of ice water.
